items.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming today in Oneonta, New York. I am pleased to have Al Gallodoro, saxophone and clarinet virtuoso.

ctx.x: You guys probably had to look very sharp in those days, tuxedos?

Oh, tell me more. Uniforms absolutely. We had two or three uniforms. Yes. We had about three. Two tails, like blue and yellow, and then short. Oh yes. In those days everybody dressed well, Monk. Everybody. We used to joke in rehearsal — where my brother bought his suit. I said, “Frank, where did you get that?” “Oh Phil Cronfeld.” Phil Cronfeld was on Broadway. That was a real man’s shop. And then you had Laten’s. There was no shagginess in those days. No.
Well you know it’s interesting because we were talking earlier about our mutual friend Joe Wilder.

items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: Oh, yeah, I’m glad you said big band. You know I want to tell you something, Monk and Spiegle. The Whiteman band was never really appreciated. We did it all.

ctx.x: Whiteman office. So that’s how I landed, that’s my portion of the Paul Whiteman part, would be through the Paul Whiteman office. And we made three Victor records with all the name is just The Collegians. But anyway, but Al is so much more, I mean has the right to say that he played with the Paul Whiteman big band.

Oh, yeah, I’m glad you said big band. You know I want to tell you something, Monk and Spiegle. The Whiteman band was never really appreciated. We did it all. We went from five saxes to seven saxes to nine saxes. We had great jazz players, the Teagarden brothers, Frankie Trumbauer, great trumpet, and great arrangements. But ‘til this day I respect Glenn Miller, I respect Benny Goodman, but nobody ever had the exposure on television and radio and television that Paul Whiteman did. We had all kinds of hours, the…
Yeah you guys share a lot of the same band mates. I know in your pictures you showed me in your home, some of the same fellows you just mentioned and the Dorsey brothers.
